run_bm_blending: run the bm_blending benchmark for sigmoid alpha and softmax blending on CUDA
benchmark_sigmoid_alpha_blending: benchmark sigmoid alpha blending across multiple image sizes and backends using fvcore
benchmark_softmax_blending: benchmark softmax blending with pytorch backend across multiple image sizes and face counts
generate_test_cases: generate test case combinations for num_meshes, image_size, faces_per_pixel, device, and backend
filter_backend_kwargs: filter benchmark kwargs to include only pytorch backend cases for softmax blending
